events.title: External Project Memory bridge must work without manual repetition
events.summary: Project outcomes produced outside SG must cross a trusted repository-backed structured handoff into the existing Project Memory automatically.
events.rationale: The Monarch requires automatic project memory and must not repeat a separate remember command after development work.

events.title: Automatic Project Memory handoff had no live ingress
events.summary: The deployed hook listened for sg_project_handoff, but the tool was not registered and the green contract test injected a synthetic tool result.

events.title: Repair the automatic external Project Memory bridge
events.summary: Register and validate the live handoff tool, ingest canonical repository handoffs before project answers, and prove the real tool-to-hook-to-Memory-Core chain.
